title: Story document
description: One repository's Story document (<work>/story-<slug>.json): the Story bead's title, description and architecture citations, written by the step `spec_authoring.story_document` (orchestrator/flows/spec_authoring.py) from the reviewed spec documents and validated against this file. The Story bead write takes the bead from it, and the task decomposer is handed it as `story document`.

title.description: The Story bead's title: the repository's name and the PRD's title.

description.description: The Story bead's description: the repository, each thing the Story builds, and the paths of its three spec documents.

decisionIds.description: The architecture citations of the contracts and the data-model documents (their decisionIds front matter), without repeats.
